M1_axis.sql: select count(*) n_trading_days, min(date) first_day, max(date) last_day, count(*) filter (where date between '2019-07-01' and '2026-10-30') n_eval_days from axis
M1_axis.note: 交易日轴 = kline_daily 全部 distinct date，不读 app/services/data_integrity.py 的近似日历

M2_panel.sql: select count(*) n_rows, count(distinct symbol) n_symbols, min(date) first_bar, max(date) last_bar, count(*) filter (where date between '2019-07-01' and '2026-10-30') n_eval_rows from bars
M2_panel.note: 面板 = 60*/00*（E3 默认板块），源 kline_daily_enriched

M3_schema_enriched.sql: select column_name, column_type from (describe select * from read_parquet('D:\TSP\data\kline_daily_enriched\date=*\*.parquet'))
M3_schema_enriched.note: enriched 实际列集：无 limit_up_price / price_limit_pct 列，涨跌停必须现算

F1_1_zero_volume.sql: select case when date between '2019-07-01' and '2026-10-30' then 'eval' else 'warmup' end win, count(*) n_rows, count(*) filter (where volume = 0) n_volume_zero, count(*) filter (where volume is null) n_volume_null, count(*) filter (where amount = 0) n_amount_zero, count(*) filter (where raw_close is null) n_raw_close_null from bars group by 1 order by 1

F1_2_gap_total.sql: select count(*) n_missing_symbol_days, count(distinct symbol) n_symbols, (select count(*) from bars where date between '2019-07-01' and '2026-10-30') n_rows_eval, round(100.0 * count(*) / ( (select count(*) from bars where date between '2019-07-01' and '2026-10-30') + count(*)), 3) pct_of_cells from gap
F1_2_gap_total.note: 口径B：停牌=当日无 bar 行（symbol 存续区间内的 axis 日缺行）；分母=有行+缺行

F1_3_gap_by_year.sql: with yb as (select year(date) y, count(*) n_rows from bars group by 1), yg as (select year(date) y, count(*) n_missing, count(distinct symbol) n_symbols from gap group by 1) select yg.y, yg.n_missing, yg.n_symbols, yb.n_rows, round(100.0*yg.n_missing/yb.n_rows, 3) pct_of_year_rows from yg join yb using (y) order by 1
F1_3_gap_by_year.note: 缺行按年，与同年行数比，用于判断采集洞年份

F1_4_gap_runs.sql: with idx as (select date, row_number() over (order by date) i from axis where date between '2019-07-01' and '2026-10-30'), gi as (select g.symbol, g.date, idx.i from gap g join idx using (date)), r as (select symbol, date, i, i - row_number() over (partition by symbol order by date) grp from gi), runs as (select symbol, grp, count(*) len from r group by 1,2) select case when len = 1 then '1' when len <= 5 then '2-5' when len <= 20 then '6-20' when len <= 60 then '21-60' when len <= 120 then '61-120' when len <= 250 then '121-250' else '>250' end bucket, count(*) n_runs, sum(len) n_symbol_days, max(len) max_len from runs group by 1 order by min(len)
F1_4_gap_runs.note: 缺口长度分布：>250 段即「长停或退市」的不可分辨区

F1_5_hole_dates.sql: with d as (select date, count(*) n_bars from bars where date between '2019-07-01' and '2026-10-30' group by 1), g as (select date, count(*) n_gap from gap group by 1), ratio as (select d.date, coalesce(g.n_gap,0) n_gap, d.n_bars, 1.0 * coalesce(g.n_gap,0) / (d.n_bars + coalesce(g.n_gap,0)) miss_ratio from d left join g using (date)), hole as (select date from ratio where miss_ratio > 0.01) select (select count(*) from hole) n_hole_dates, (select count(*) from ratio where miss_ratio > 0.01) n_hole_days, (select count(*) from gap g join hole h on h.date = g.date) n_gap_on_hole, round(100.0 * (select count(*) from gap g join hole h on h.date = g.date) / (select count(*) from gap), 1) pct_gap_on_hole, (select max(miss_ratio) from ratio) max_daily_miss_ratio
F1_5_hole_dates.note: 采集洞判据：当日「缺行 /(有行+缺行) > 1%」；落在洞日上的缺行是采集缺陷，不能当停牌

F2_1_null_limit_up.note: = 每只首根 bar（无昨收）+ 无涨跌幅限制日（新股/复牌）

result.id: limit_up_price 为 null 的标的日
price_limit_pct 为 null 的标的日
涨停且 raw_high==raw_low（一字板，确定不可成交）
涨停但日内有价格变动（不可成交性需分钟线）
全日一价但非涨跌停（停牌/冻结形态）
raw_high 超涨停价 0.006 以上（口径异常）

F2_9_pct_crosstab.note: price_limit_pct × st_flag × 2026-07-06 之后；ST 档位是否真的 5%

result.id: 涨停日次日开盘即涨停（已剔除次日除权行）

F2_12_up_next_open_at_limit.note: raw_open 不在 enriched 里，用前复权 open 近似

result.id: 涨停日次日开盘价即达涨停价（T+1 开盘买不到，含除权日）

F3_1_no_delist_column.sql: select count(*) filter (where lower(column_name) like '%delist%') n_delist_cols, count(*) filter (where lower(column_name) in ('status','is_active','list_status')) n_status_cols, string_agg(column_name, ',') filter (where true) all_cols from (describe select * from inst)
F3_1_no_delist_column.note: instruments 13 列里按名字找退市/状态列

F3_2_limit_cols_empty.sql: select count(*) n_rows, count(limit_up) n_limit_up_nonnull, count(limit_down) n_limit_down_nonnull, min(as_of) as_of_min, max(as_of) as_of_max from inst
F3_2_limit_cols_empty.note: instruments.limit_up/limit_down 是否可用于涨跌停（应为全空 + 单期快照）

F3_3_last_bar_year.sql: with lb as (select symbol, max(date) last_bar from bars group by 1) select year(last_bar) y, count(*) n_symbols from lb where last_bar < (select max(date) from bars) group by 1 order by 1
F3_3_last_bar_year.note: 无退市字段时的唯一代理：最后一根 bar 所在年（事后信息）

F3_4_gone_buckets.sql: with lb as (select symbol, max(date) last_bar from bars group by 1), cal as (select date, row_number() over (order by date) di from axis), j as (select lb.symbol, (select max(di) from cal) - c.di missing_days from lb join cal c on c.date = lb.last_bar where lb.last_bar < (select max(date) from bars)) select case when missing_days < 5 then '<5' when missing_days < 20 then '5-19' when missing_days < 60 then '20-59' when missing_days < 120 then '60-119' when missing_days < 250 then '120-249' else '>=250' end bucket, count(*) n_symbols from j group by 1 order by min(missing_days)
F3_4_gone_buckets.note: 「已消失」按缺失交易日数分档；<60 日无法区分停牌与退市

F3_5_instruments_no_bar.sql: with allbar as (select distinct symbol from read_parquet('D:\TSP\data\kline_daily\date=*\*.parquet')) select count(*) n_ins_no_bar, count(*) filter (where symbol like '60%' or symbol like '00%') n_panel from inst anti join allbar using (symbol)
F3_5_instruments_no_bar.note: 维表里有、K 线里一根都没有（多为退市壳）

F3_6_bj_no_instruments.sql: with allbar as (select distinct symbol from read_parquet('D:\TSP\data\kline_daily\date=*\*.parquet')) select (select count(*) from allbar where symbol like '%.BJ') n_bj_bars, (select count(*) from inst where symbol like '%.BJ') n_bj_inst, (select count(*) from allbar) n_symbols_all_boards
F3_6_bj_no_instruments.note: 北交所有 K 线无维表行 → 上市日/退市日均不可得

F3_7_resume_after_gap.sql: with idx as (select date, row_number() over (order by date) i from axis where date between '2019-07-01' and '2026-10-30'), gi as (select g.symbol, g.date, idx.i from gap g join idx using (date)), r as (select symbol, date, i, i - row_number() over (partition by symbol order by date) grp from gi), runs as (select symbol, grp, count(*) len, min(date) s, max(date) e from r group by symbol, grp having count(*) > 250) select count(*) n_runs_gt250, count(distinct symbol) n_symbols, max(len) max_len from runs
F3_7_resume_after_gap.note: >250 交易日缺口里后来是否复牌（证伪「无行情=退市」的充分性）

F3_8_resume_samples.sql: with idx as (select date, row_number() over (order by date) i from axis where date between '2019-07-01' and '2026-10-30'), gi as (select g.symbol, g.date, idx.i from gap g join idx using (date)), r as (select symbol, date, i, i - row_number() over (partition by symbol order by date) grp from gi), runs as (select symbol, grp, count(*) len, min(date) s, max(date) e from r group by symbol, grp having count(*) > 250) select symbol, len, s, e from runs order by len desc limit 10
F3_8_resume_samples.note: 最长的几段缺口（这些标的后来都复牌了，因此「长期无行情」不等于退市）

F3_9_name_tui_still_trading.sql: with lb as (select symbol, max(date) last_bar from read_parquet('D:\TSP\data\kline_daily\date=*\*.parquet') group by 1) select count(*) n_name_has_tui, count(*) filter (where lb.symbol is not null) n_has_bar, count(*) filter (where lb.last_bar >= date '2026-10-30') n_trading_at_tail from inst i left join lb using (symbol) where i.name like '%退%'
F3_9_name_tui_still_trading.note: 现名含「退」的证券是否仍在数据末端交易（名字不是历史状态，不能当日判据）

F4_1_listing_coverage.sql: select count(*) n_inst, count(listing_date) n_listing_nonnull, count(*) filter (where symbol like '60%' or symbol like '00%') n_panel, count(listing_date) filter (where symbol like '60%' or symbol like '00%') n_panel_nonnull, min(listing_date) ld_min, max(listing_date) ld_max from inst
F4_1_listing_coverage.note: listing_date 是 VARCHAR；60/00 域非空率

F4_1b_listing_panel_with_bars.sql: with ps as (select distinct symbol from bars) select count(*) n_panel_with_bar, count(i.listing_date) n_listing_nonnull from ps left join inst i using (symbol)
F4_1b_listing_panel_with_bars.note: 有 K 线的 60/00 标的的 listing_date 非空率（E3 实际用到的那部分）

F4_2_first_bar_eq_listing.sql: with ps as (select symbol, min(date) fb from bars group by 1) select case when cast(substr(i.listing_date,1,10) as date) >= date '2018-01-08' then 'listed_after_panel_start' else 'listed_before_panel_start' end grp, count(*) n_symbols, count(*) filter (where ps.fb = cast(substr(i.listing_date,1,10) as date)) n_first_bar_eq_listing from ps join inst i using (symbol) where (symbol like '60%' or symbol like '00%') group by 1
F4_2_first_bar_eq_listing.note: 首根 bar 是否等于上市日：决定「bar 序号能否当上市天数」

F4_3_ob120_deviation.sql: with j as ( select b.symbol, b.date, count(*) over (partition by b.symbol order by b.date rows between unbounded preceding and current row) ob, cast(substr(i.listing_date,1,10) as date) ld from bars b join inst i using (symbol) ), e as (select * from j where date between '2019-07-01' and '2026-10-30') select count(*) n_symbol_days, count(*) filter (where ob >= 120) n_ob120, count(*) filter (where ob < 120 and date_diff('day', ld, date) >= 120) n_naive_calendar_would_include, count(*) filter (where ob >= 120 and date_diff('day', ld, date) < 120) n_ob120_but_calendar_lt120, count(*) filter (where ld is null) n_listing_null from e
F4_3_ob120_deviation.note: observed_bars（自首根 bar 累计）>=120 与「自然日差>=120」的偏差标的日数；ob 从每只首根 bar 起算

F4_5_first_bar_lag.sql: with ps as (select symbol, min(date) fb from bars group by 1) select count(*) n_listed_after_panel_start, count(*) filter (where ps.fb > cast(substr(i.listing_date,1,10) as date)) n_first_bar_later_than_listing, max(date_diff('day', cast(substr(i.listing_date,1,10) as date), ps.fb)) max_lag_days from ps join inst i using (symbol) where (symbol like '60%' or symbol like '00%') and cast(substr(i.listing_date,1,10) as date) >= date '2018-01-08'
F4_5_first_bar_lag.note: 只看数据起点之后上市的标的：首根 bar 是否晚于上市日（2018 年前上市的会被面板起点截断，不计入）

F4_4_warmup_effect.sql: with ps as (select symbol, min(date) fb from bars group by 1) select count(*) filter (where fb > date '2019-07-01') n_listed_inside_eval, count(*) filter (where cast(substr(i.listing_date,1,10) as date) > date '2019-07-01') n_listing_inside_eval from ps join inst i using (symbol) where (symbol like '60%' or symbol like '00%')
F4_4_warmup_effect.note: 评估窗内新上市标的数：其 observed_bars 自动 <120，需要 listing_date 才能区分「新股」与「缺数据」

F5_1_st_shape.sql: select count(*) n_rows, count(distinct symbol) n_symbols, min(flag_date) first_flag, max(flag_date) last_flag, count(*) filter (where st_flag) n_true, count(*) filter (where not st_flag) n_false from sth

F5_2_st_episodes_by_year.sql: select year(flag_date) y, count(*) n_flags, count(distinct symbol) n_symbols, count(*) filter (where st_flag) n_enter, count(*) filter (where not st_flag) n_exit from sth group by 1 order by 1
F5_2_st_episodes_by_year.note: 每年 ST 进出事件数；2026 年是否异常少

F5_3_st_asof_window.sql: with d as (select date from axis where date between date '2026-10-12' and date '2026-11-06'), latest as ( select d.date, s.symbol, s.st_flag, row_number() over (partition by d.date, s.symbol order by s.flag_date desc) rn from d left join sth s on s.flag_date <= d.date ), cur as (select date, symbol, st_flag from latest where rn = 1), bars_per_day as (select date, count(*) n_active from bars where date between date '2026-10-12' and date '2026-11-06' group by 1) select d.date, coalesce(b.n_active,0) n_bars_panel, count(*) filter (where cur.st_flag) n_st_true, count(*) filter (where cur.st_flag is null) n_st_null, count(*) filter (where cur.st_flag is false) n_st_false from d left join cur on cur.date = d.date left join bars_per_day b on b.date = d.date group by 1,2 order by 1
F5_3_st_asof_window.note: as-of 口径逐日 ST 家数（含 2026-10-20..10-29 八日窗口）

F5_4_st_window_8d.sql: with d as (select date from axis where date between '2026-10-20' and '2026-10-29'), cur as ( select d.date, count(*) filter (where s.st_flag) n_st_true, count(*) n_symbols from d left join sth s on s.flag_date = d.date group by 1 ) select (select count(*) from d) n_days, (select count(*) from sth where flag_date between '2026-10-20' and '2026-10-29') n_st_flags_in_window, (select count(*) from sth where flag_date <= '2026-10-29' and st_flag) n_st_true_cum
F5_4_st_window_8d.note: 窗口内是否有任何 ST 状态变更事件（=0 说明该段无法反映真实 ST 变动）

F5_5_st_coverage.sql: with ps as (select distinct symbol from bars where (symbol like '60%' or symbol like '00%')), sts as (select distinct symbol from sth) select (select count(*) from ps) n_panel_symbols, (select count(*) from ps join sts using (symbol)) n_panel_symbols_in_st, (select count(*) from sts) n_st_symbols, (select min(flag_date) from sth) st_first_flag, (select max(flag_date) from sth) st_last_flag
F5_5_st_coverage.note: 面板标的中有 ST 历史行的比例（无行=从未 ST，非缺失）

F5_7_st_window_events.sql: select flag_date, st_flag, count(*) n_rows, count(distinct symbol) n_symbols from sth where flag_date between date '2026-10-15' and date '2026-10-30' group by 1,2 order by 1,2
F5_7_st_window_events.note: 2026-10-20 前后 ST 状态变更事件：一次性把大批准 ST 置 False（=末端截断）

F5_8_st_dropped_by_truncation.sql: with before as ( select count(*) n from ( select symbol, arg_max(st_flag, flag_date) f from sth where flag_date <= date '2026-10-19' group by 1) where f ), after as ( select count(*) n from ( select symbol, arg_max(st_flag, flag_date) f from sth where flag_date <= date '2026-10-29' group by 1) where f ) select (select n from before) n_st_true_on_1019, (select n from after) n_st_true_on_1029, (select n from before) - (select n from after) n_dropped
F5_8_st_dropped_by_truncation.note: 截断造成的 ST=True 家数下降（可用于估偏差量级）

F5_6_st_pre2019.sql: select min(flag_date) first_flag, (select count(*) from sth where flag_date < date '2019-01-01') n_pre_2019 from sth
F5_6_st_pre2019.note: 2019 年前的 ST 记录：0 条 → 2019-07-01 之前必须给 null
